summary: Iteration 69 — Backend 19/19 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter69_session_orders_push.py covering (A) /auth/refresh grace path: replaying the ORIGINAL refresh token after a legitimate rotation returns 200 + usable access token; a truly unknown/revoked sid still 401s. (B) Per-device eviction: 3 back-to-back logins on X-Device-FP 'A' do NOT invalidate device 'B''s access token or refresh; re-login on same FP invalidates the old refresh (stale sid rejected). (C) /auth/logout only kills the calling device's session — other device survives on /auth/me AND /auth/refresh. (D) Scoped RBAC additions: products_manager GET /admin/vendors → 200, POST vendor endpoint blocked; layout_manager GET /admin/products → 200, POST /admin/products → 403; both blocked out-of-area. (E) Admin orders enrichment: /admin/orders rows now carry buyer_name/email/phone + vendor_name/email/phone; /admin/orders/{id} returns {order, siblings}; super_admin AND order_manager can read, other managers 403. (F) core.notifications.create_notification default push=True fires routes.push.send_push (mocked); push=False suppresses; ConnectionManager.set_viewing/is_viewing toggle works (WS-level protocol backing the chat push suppression). FRONTEND VERIFIED via Playwright (390x844 mobile viewport): (1) Services tab (/(tabs)/services) — services-use-location card rendered at Y=127 and BROWSE BY CATEGORY at Y=208 (ABOVE ✓); after scrolling 500px the location card stayed at Y=127 (STICKY ✓). (2) Provider profile — get-phone-btn and start-chat-btn have EQUAL width (174px each) at Y=774 at 390px viewport (no overflow ✓); phone displayed above buttons (9999900000, UNLOCKED tag). (3) Admin → Orders (super_admin) — each card shows the order number (SC-9D8B50-1), Buyer · 9999999999, Test Vendor seller shop line, product hero, per-order status tracker and 'TAP FOR FULL DETAILS' hint; tapping the card opens the detail sheet (testID order-detail-close) with a hero card, CUSTOMER (Name/Phone/Email — Buyer / 9999999999 / testbuyer@test.com), SELLER (Shop/Phone/Email — Test Vendor / 9876543210 / testvendor@test.com), PAYMENT (Method COD, wallet/COD split, order total), ITEMS list, DELIVERY ADDRESS block, and SAME CHECKOUT section listing the sibling sub-order. (4) Scoped managers — layoutmanager@test.com landing at /admin/manager-home shows 'Shop live preview' row that opens /admin/shop; the shop page renders (no 403) and the quick-manage chips are correctly filtered — layout manager sees ONLY Layout + Categories (no Products, no Orders). (5) Regression — dashboard-avatar (testID dashboard-avatar) NAVIGATES to /profile after tap (previous iteration's bug is fixed: hitSlop and pointerEvents='none' on the inner Text now let the parent TouchableOpacity receive the tap); Login activity screen accessible from Profile. (6) Admin → Users tap crash fix — tapped 3 different admin-user-<uuid> rows in sequence, Edit modal opened cleanly each time, PASSWORD card (Show password/Reset & reveal) rendered on each open, NO 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' error surfaced in the DOM or console. NOTES: Biometric fingerprint (3-attempt fallback) and phone tray notifications cannot be verified on web/Playwright and are not native-buildable in this env — verified via code-path inspection and the send_push mock assertion instead.

action_items: None blocking — all iteration 69 targets verified. OPTIONAL: /auth/login is still rate-limited at 10/min per IP; the test file uses a token cache + 35s backoff, but any additional test suite that logs in freely should reuse tokens or add per-suite pacing.

OPTIONAL: dashboard-avatar tap now works but STILL requires two forced clicks on the first navigation from a fresh page.goto because the Slangcart splash overlay eats the first tap. Not a functional bug — this is Reanimated + web preview timing. If you want to make Playwright-first tests smoother, either fade the splash out sooner or gate the router push behind a splash-dismissed flag.

OPTIONAL: /admin/orders card has a proper testID `order-<uuid>` and works; the FlatList container also emits `order-tab-all` / `order-tab-placed`… — consider renaming those filter pills to `order-filter-<slug>` to avoid the two prefix families colliding in tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py refresh grace path (lines 660-691) correctly walks the rotation chain (up to 6 hops) via core.security.rotation_target, honours ROTATION_GRACE_SECONDS (default 300s from env), and mints a NEW access token bound to the CURRENT sid — so a phone that missed the rotation response silently recovers instead of being logged out. Genuinely unknown sids still 401 session_revoked (test_a2).

core/login_history.py record_login (lines 107-116) pulls stale session IDs belonging to THIS SAME device_fp only, so repeated logins on device A cannot evict device B's sid from the 10-slot active_session_ids pool — verified end-to-end in test_b1.

core/security.py ADMIN_AREAS (lines 349-380) uses the 'METHOD /path' rule format: layout_manager can 'GET /admin/products' but any POST/PATCH/DELETE on /admin/products is blocked by the same guard. products_manager similarly gets read-only 'GET /admin/vendors'. Confirmed with real HTTP calls in test_d1..d6.

server.py _attach_order_parties (lines 6099-6127) does ONE batched find({id: {$in: [buyerIds, sellerIds]}}) so the list stays fast; every row is guaranteed to have the six new keys (buyer_name/email/phone + vendor_name/email/phone) — even when the underlying user document is missing (falls back to shipping_address name/phone). Good defensive coding.

core/notifications.py create_notification (line 27) now defaults push=True and imports routes.push.send_push lazily inside a try/except — a push-relay outage cannot break the notification write. Two callers correctly opt out with push=False: routes/chat.py::send_message (line 735) and the order-placed / order-status helpers (grepped, all pass push=False so they don't double-push after their explicit send_push).

routes/chat.py::send_message (line 743) now guards the tray push on manager.is_viewing(other_id, thread_id) INSTEAD of manager.is_online. A backgrounded but connected socket now gets the push; only a user actively reading that thread is suppressed. The in-app bell row (create_notification with push=False) fires unconditionally on line 729, so a user who is looking at the chat still gets a bell entry — matches the acceptance criteria.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter69_session_orders_push.py is safe to re-run in ~75s (module-level token cache + 35s backoff on 429). If running alongside test_iter68_login_history.py, sleep 45s between suites to avoid hitting the 10/min /auth/login rate limit. The refresh-grace tests DEPEND on ROTATION_GRACE_SECONDS >= 60 (default 300s); if that env var is lowered for other tests, test_a1 will fail intermittently. The notification tests use a SHARED asyncio loop (_SHARED_LOOP) because motor binds to the first loop that touches the db collection — do NOT switch to asyncio.run() inside those tests. Frontend caveat: /admin/orders card testIDs are `order-<uuid>` while the filter-pills use `order-tab-<slug>` — filter DOM queries with a UUID regex when picking a card to tap, or you'll click the ALL pill by mistake (I did this once). The Slangcart splash overlay still eats the FIRST tap after page.goto — always click twice with a 1.5s pause or wait for a screen-specific testID before the first interaction.
